events.text: Live AWS EKS deployment before rollout: backend reports the original image commit.
Scientific calculator on EKS: evaluate sqrt(144) + 2^3 and persist the result in PostgreSQL.
Degree mode: sin(30) = 0.5. The shared notebook is stored outside application pods.
The new Git commit triggered tests, image builds, strict Trivy scans, SHA-tag publishing and a real cluster demonstration.
Pipeline passed. Both exact scanned images are published with full SHA tags. The optional hosted EKS job is disabled; the following Helm rollout is run from the authenticated local CLI.
Roll both EKS application deployments to the successful commit SHA; wait for readiness and the migration Job.
After rollout: /api/health reports the new commit SHA from the EKS deployment.
The notebook still contains the scientific calculations after the pod replacement.

description: Actual technical walkthrough. Commit metadata uses the owner-assigned timestamp; capture and hosted run times are actual.
